description: Delay hours by category for ONE Realized To-Date scope: the same rollup as dvw-jfb-realized-delay-summary-v2 plus the scope's area filter, so a project running two contracts on different ground does not show one contract's delays against the other's hours. Area matching uses the LEVEL-1 area id, as the reference app does. p_include_ids / p_exclude_ids are comma-delimited text because published data views only accept scalar parameters; empty strings mean every area, which reproduces the unscoped view exactly. Rewritten 2026-09-24 alongside the unscoped view: category-based, no delay-code join, zero-length activities excluded. Area, pass, TSCA and attachment are the activity's EFFECTIVE values (tr/ea laterals): an activity with no area of its own takes all four from the latest TRANSITION marker on the same equipment and report_date at or before its start, and one with its own area keeps it but takes the marker's attachment when it has none -- the non-native app's buildCombosFromEvents rule, mirrored client-side in src/lib/transitionState.js. Change one and you must change the other.
direct_sql: SELECT btrim(da.category) AS description, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0) AS hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.area, t.pass_type, t.tsca, t.attachment_id FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities t WHERE (NOT (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') OR da.attachment_id IS NULL) AND upper(btrim(t.category)) = 'TRANSITION' AND t.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND t.project_id = da.project_id AND t.equipment_id = da.equipment_id AND t.report_date = da.report_date AND t.start_date_time <= da.start_date_time ORDER BY t.start_date_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) tr ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.area ELSE tr.area END AS area, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.pass_type ELSE tr.pass_type END AS pass_type, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.tsca ELSE tr.tsca END AS tsca, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN COALESCE(da.attachment_id, tr.attachment_id) ELSE tr.attachment_id END AS attachment_id) ea WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.report_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND da.end_date_time > da.start_date_time AND upper(btrim(da.category)) NOT IN ('ACTIVE DREDGING', 'DREDGING', 'PRODUCTION', 'ACTIVE CAPPING', 'CAPPING', 'ACTIVE PLACEMENT', 'PLACEMENT', 'TRANSITION') AND (p_include_ids = '' OR COALESCE(ea.area->>'area_id', '') = ANY (string_to_array(p_include_ids, ','))) AND (p_exclude_ids = '' OR COALESCE(ea.area->>'area_id', '') <> ALL (string_to_array(p_exclude_ids, ','))) GROUP BY btrim(da.category) ORDER BY hours DESC

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range -- typically the captured week's Monday.

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range -- typically the captured week's Sunday.

parameters.name: p_include_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated jfb_project_areas ids to count, or '' for every area.

parameters.name: p_exclude_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated jfb_project_areas ids to leave out, or '' for none. Applied after p_include_ids.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The activity's own category text, e.g. 'Survey' or 'STARTUP/SHUTDOWN' -- one row per distinct category. This is the label the reference app prints; it is NOT the delay code's name, and two categories that map to the same code stay separate, exactly as the reference shows them.

columns.name: hours
columns.description: Summed activity duration in hours for that category over the date range.
